system.description:
You focus your relentless savagery into your flail and lash out at everything and everyone around you, striking with enough strength to shatter the ground, branding the entire area. All creatures of your choice within range, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking you [Weapons damage] + 4d12 or half as much on a success.

Regardless of a success or failure, all creatures whom you dealt damage to becomes Branded reminding them of your savagery.

All Branded creatures cannot declare attacks or cast jutsu within the given area for the next minute, being forced to escape the affected radius in order to fight effectively or until they spend a full-turn action to remove the branding

Chain 3: While branded, the target creature has 4 ranks of Sealed.
